Results

The luminance of the sun at noon is 1.6 × 109 cd/m2. The luminance of a clear blue sky is around 5000 cd/m2 (compared with 300 for a TV display and 150–250 cd/m2 for a computer screen). The other sources of natural blue light are the moon and flames.

Currently, there is no evidence that screen use and LEDs in normal use are deleterious1 to the human retina2.
